Sure—let’s get started with some basic checks. First, can you please provide the phone number associated with the line that’s having trouble sending MMS? Once I have that, I can look up your account and walk you through the troubleshooting steps.
Oh, of course. My phone number is 555-123-2002. What do I need to do next?

Let’s start by verifying your network connection:
